AskAnswered.description:
A person answers an ask of another runner, with `priory answer RUNNER:ASK`. Only that runner
applies it, with the revision check of a local answer.

ask.description: The ask's id on that runner.

by.description: Where the answer came from: `cli` or `serve`.

revision.description: The question revision the person read.

run.description: True when the person confirmed that the answer runs the ask's command.

runner.description: The runner whose ask it answers.

submission.description: The answer's own message id, which the runner's `priory.ask.applied` names.

description:
A person answers an ask of another runner, with `priory answer RUNNER:ASK`. Only that runner

id.description: A UUIDv5 of the message's name, so a retried publish keeps its id.

links.description: GitHub and Linear events carry one link to the event's page.

subject.description: A short line for listings, such as `owner/name#42`.

title: priory.ask.answered
